I've reviewed all three files. Here's my analysis and fixes.

## Issues Found

### 1. `global.json` — SDK pinned to 8.0.300
Must update to .NET 9 SDK. Adding `rollForward` prevents breakage on patch updates.

### 2. `MultiTarget.csproj` — `net7.0` is EOL
.NET 7 ended support May 2024. Replace with `net9.0`. (`net8.0` and `netstandard1.6` remain valid.)

### 3. Visual Studio 2022 17.11 — doesn't support .NET 9
.NET 9 SDK requires **VS 2022 17.12 or later**. Developers on 17.11 will get build errors. **This must be communicated to the team before merging.**

### 4. `ci-build.sh` — no issues
`dotnet build` warning detection and `dotnet workload list | grep` continue to work with SDK 9. No changes needed.

### 5. `dotnet watch` — no issues
Already requires `--framework net8.0` for multi-targeted projects (two runnable TFMs existed before and after). This is unchanged.

---
